keep.text: Usernames are 3 to 20 characters, letters and digits only

repo_rule.why: follows the out-of-date docstring: 3 to 20 letters and digits, case-sensitive

chat1_only.why: knows only chat 1: 4 to 16 letters, digits and underscores, so no 24 and no dots

chat2_only.why: knows only chat 2 (up to 24, dots too) and takes the rest from the docstring: 3 at least, no underscores, case-sensitive

max_off_by_one.why: len(name) in range(4, 24), which refuses a name of exactly 24

half_casefold.why: lowercases the new name but not the taken ones, so alice is free while Alice is taken
